Aberdeen, UK Scotland’s first minister, John Swinney, stands alongside a cardboard cutout of Dolly Parton promoting the Imagination Library during a tour of the exhibitors’ hall at the Scottish National party’s annual conference.
Motherwell, UK Andy Burnham speaks to a student during a visit to a college before a speech focusing on forming closer ties with the Scottish government.
Paisley, UK The Conservative party leader, Kemi Badenoch, on a visit to the Malcolm Group, a logistics firm, as rival parties look to grab attention away from the SNP conference.
Hexham, UK Members of the Hexham rowing club out for an early morning row on the River Tyne in Northumberland.
Turin, Italy Students take part in No Meloni Day, a national day of marches inspired by student protests in France and Spain.
Brussels, Belgium Giorgia Meloni greets Volodymyr Zelenskyy at an EU summit.
Jerusalem, Israel A man plays the saxophone as others hold a banner depicting Benjamin Netanyahu while gathering at Mahane Yehuda market in the run-up to this month’s elections.
Istanbul, Turkey Heavy rainfall has muddied the waters of the Bosphorus.
Paraná, Brazil A walkway is engulfed by high waters at Iguazu Falls after heavy rain.
Nuwakot, Nepal A newly installed suspension bridge across the Trishuli River after the recent devastating flood.
Turmus Ayya, West Bank Firefighters douse a burnt car after settlers attacked a group of Palestinians during the olive harvest.
Gaza City, Gaza Displaced Palestinian children watch a film at a makeshift open-air cinema near the ruins of destroyed buildings in the Sheikh Redwan neighbourhood.
Naples, Italy A blanket of black smoke rises over the city after a warehouse fire.
Buenos Aires, Argentina Police forces deploy teargas, water cannon and rubber bullets against demonstrators during protests against Javier Milei’s austerity policies.
Malibu, California A firefighting helicopter drops water over the Bryson wildfire.
Calgary, Canada Mark Carney, the prime minister, interacts with people at a Forever Canadian rally ahead of a referendum on Alberta’s sovereignty.
Sydney, Australia A woman looks at a sculpture titled Surface Breach by the artist Andre Braun on the opening day of the Sculpture by the Sea outdoor exhibition in Bondi.
Crowds of people walk along a slightly curved bit of wall that descends down a hillside.
Shuangyashan, China A drying yard at sunrise in north-east Heilongjiang, China’s top grain-producing province, which is in full swing during the autumn harvest.
Brussels, Belgium Heads of member states at an EU summit.
Nottingham, UK The Duke and Duchess of Sussex arrive for a visit to Community Recording Studio, a charity supporting young people through creative activities, mentoring and development.
Sudbury, UK Myriad, a luminarium created by Architects of Air, offers an immersive experience of kaleidoscopic colour, at the National Trust’s Children’s Country House in Derbyshire.
Muğla, Turkey An aerial view of the winding waterways, reed beds and wetlands of the Dalyan delta, where boat tours take visitors through the area toward İztuzu beach in the Ortaca district.

Jabaliya, Gaza Palestinian schoolchildren are ushered away from the site of an Israeli drone strike that reportedly killed one person in the northern Gaza Strip. Despite a US-backed ceasefire that took effect in October 2025, violence has not halted in the strip, with Israel continuing to target Palestinians it says are militants.
Badung, Indonesia Motorcyclists queue to refuel at a state-owned Pertamina petrol station amid a fuel supply shortage in Bali.
St Louis, US The St Louis City goalkeeper Roman Bürki deflects a shot during the first half of an MLS match against the Vancouver Whitecaps in Missouri.

Lorient, France The French skipper Charles Caudrelier sails his Ultim multihull Gitana 18, Edmond de Rothschild, during a training session before the Route du Rhum solo sailing race from Saint-Malo, western France, to Pointe-à-Pitre in the French overseas island of Guadeloupe.
Jabaliya, Gaza An injured Palestinian woman is carried away from the site of an Israeli drone strike.
Glasgow, UK A visitor explores the light installations in the Glasshouses at Glasgow Botanic Gardens during a preview of GlasGLOW Zombie Zoo.
Tirana, Albania A demonstrator smashes a window during clashes with police amid an anti-government protest by students.
Tirana, Albania Hooded protesters vandalise a bank during clashes as students join the ‘flamingo’ anti-government movement.
Beijing, China Tourists at the Badaling section of the Great Wall.
Dnipro, Ukraine People stand at the site of a private house destroyed by a Russian airstrike.
Montana, US Donald Trump walks towards his vehicle after disembarking Air Force One at Glacier Park international airport. The US president travelled to Montana to speak at a campaign rally.
Motorcyclists and cars travel through thick orange wildfire haze in Palangkaraya, Indonesia.
Madrid, Spain Students join teachers in a protest over school conditions, classroom sizes and pay.

Chaman, Pakistan Security officials stand guard as supporters of the Pashtoonkhwa Milli Awami party take part in a protest. Opposition leaders announced nationwide peaceful demonstrations against emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, a stronghold of the jailed former prime minister Imran Khan’s party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.
Rome, Italy TV camera crews wait in front of the Gemelli university hospital where Pope Leo is recovering from surgery after a lung cancer diagnosis.

Delhi, India Security personnel detain a student activist during a protest demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar. Anger over the removal 130m names from the electoral roll has sparked a crisis for Narendra Modi’s Hindu nationalist government.

London, UK Andy Burnham leaves 10 Downing Street to attend prime minister’s questions in the House of Commons. During PMQs, Burnham ruled out Labour doing any deals with the Greens as he condemned the latter’s ‘Zionism is racism’ policy as ‘antisemitic’.

Shoham, Israel Workers pack ballots and polling station equipment at the Central Elections Committee’s logistics centre before legislative polls on 27 October. Uncertainty hangs over an election that could mark a turning point for a country profoundly changed after the Hamas attacks of 7 October 2023 and nearly three years of war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

Shenyang, China A woman pushes an electric bike loaded with cabbages at a market in north-east Liaoning province. China’s producer price index has climbed at its fastest pace in more than four years, rising 5% in September, as higher fuel prices pushed up business costs.

London, UK A boat with a banner that reads ‘Enough of this crap, save our seas!’ passes the Tower of London on the River Thames. The actor Danny Dyer and the Labour MP Kevin McKenna will deliver a petition 10 Downing Street on Wednesday calling on the government to return the water industry to public ownership.

Gorkha, Nepal Damaged houses lie partially submerged in sludge along the banks of the Budhi Gandaki River after a flash flood caused by a landslide. Four bridges and dozens of houses were swept away, as well as a construction camp for a hydropower project.

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam A woman stands beside caskets holding the remains of fallen soldiers at Lê Thị Riêng cultural park. Vietnam held funeral rites for more than 700 of its war dead on Wednesday, unearthed in a push to identify those missing from decades of conflict with France and the US.

Mikhmas, West Bank A Palestinian man inspects a damaged car after an alleged attack by Israeli settlers. According to the Wafa news agency, Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque, an olive tree and a vehicle in the village in the early hours of the morning.

Kyiv, Ukraine Flames engulf a residential building after a Russian airstrike. Russia continues to launch ballistic missiles and Shahed drones in large-scale attacks on Kyiv’s residential areas and infrastructure. Five districts of the city experienced blackouts and water supply issues after the overnight barrage.

Wasilla, Alaska Donald Trump arrives for a campaign rally at the Curtis D Menard Memorial Sports Center. Trump is campaigning in Alaska for local Republican candidates three weeks before the midterm elections.

Caracas, Venezuela A woman with the Venezuelan flag draped around her shoulders confronts a police officer near the presidential palace during a protest by active and former health and education workers, as well as relatives of political prisoners. The protesters are demanding salary increases and the release of political prisoners.
